card.name: Space before chemo dose numbers; RNA enzymes
card.fires_on: Fires on the space just before a chemotherapy dose or schedule number (e.g. 'every' then '3 weeks'), and on 'RNA' or 'topoisom' in enzyme names such as RNA polymerase or triphosphatase.

modes.label: Space before dose number
modes.description: A bare space token right before a number in a chemotherapy dose or schedule.
